title: UI风格#124 - Synthwave Highway (合成波公路)
description: 创建第124种UI风格：合成波公路风格 - 80年代霓虹、公路旅途、老爷车。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDT.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway style When color palette Then features neon purple, hot pink, cyan, chrome silver, sunset orange
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#9932CC (霓虹紫), #FF1493 (热粉), #00CED1 (青色), #C0C0C0 (铬银), #FF7F50 (日落橙)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway style When typography Then uses retrofuturistic: Outrun, Cyberpunk, or Whisper
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Outrun (标题), Cyberpunk (正文), Whisper (装饰)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway style When layout Then infinite highway, sunset backdrop, palm silhouettes, retrofuturistic city
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：无限公路、日落背景、棕榈剪影、复古未来城市

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway style When UI elements Then chrome reflections, neon glow, grid horizon, VHS artifacts
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：铬反光、霓虹发光、网格地平线、VHS伪影

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway UI When functional Then includes road trip chat, cruiser agents, mile stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：公路旅行聊天、巡洋舰代理、英里统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Synthwave Highway UI When copy Then uses road trip: 'Highway', 'Cruise', 'Sunset', 'Endless'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'HIGHWAY. CRUISE. SUNSET.'、按钮'SEND'→'DRIVE'、'SUBMIT'→'ACCELERATE'
